headline: One of the Hungarian Battery Factories Is Shutting Down
summary: A Hungarian factory producing battery raw materials in Vácrátót is shutting down, with the closure attributed to general market difficulties. The Hungarian subsidiary of Japan's Nippon Paper has 24 employees.
why: Nippon Paper is a Japanese paper and specialty materials producer, and battery material plants in Europe are watched as signals of demand in the electric vehicle supply chain.
